description: This source file defines a SwiftUI view called ConfigSettings, which provides a configuration interface with sections and subsections, including logic for loading schemas, handling user interactions, and displaying schemas with forms.

classes.name: ConfigSettings
classes.description: Main SwiftUI View for configuration settings, implementing sections, subsections, and schema-driven forms.

classes.name: ConfigSection
classes.description: Represents a section in the configuration UI with key, label, help, and schema node.

classes.name: ConfigSubsection
classes.description: Represents a subsection within a config section, with key, label, help, schema node, and path.

classes.name: SubsectionSelection
classes.description: Enum to manage active subsections, either all or a specific key.

methods.name: sections
methods.description: Computes and resolves the list of configuration sections from the schema.

methods.name: activeSection
methods.description: Returns the currently active section based on activeSectionKey.

methods.name: sidebar
methods.description: Constructs the sidebar view with list of sections and subsections.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Constructs the detail view for the active section or loading state.

methods.name: sectionDetail
methods.description: Builds the detailed view for a selected section, including form and status.

methods.name: emptyDetail
methods.description: View displayed when no schema or section is available.

methods.name: sectionHeader
methods.description: Renders header info for a section.

methods.name: actionRow
methods.description: Provides buttons for reloading and saving configuration.

methods.name: sidebarSection
methods.description: Builds a expandable/collapsible section item in the sidebar.

methods.name: sidebarSubRow
methods.description: Builds a subsection item within a section in the sidebar.

methods.name: sectionForm
methods.description: Returns a schema-driven form for the selected section and subsection.

methods.name: ensureSelection
methods.description: Ensures an active section and subsection are selected based on current schema.

methods.name: ensureSubsection
methods.description: Ensures a subsection is selected within a section.

methods.name: selectSection
methods.description: Sets the active section and initializes its first subsection.

methods.name: resolveSections
methods.description: Resolves and sorts section definitions from schema and hints.

methods.name: resolveSubsections
methods.description: Resolves and sorts subsections of a section based on schema and hints.

methods.name: resolvedSchemaNode
methods.description: Resolves schema node variants, preferring non-null schemas.

methods.name: humanize
methods.description: Converts snake_case or kebab-case keys into human-readable labels.
